categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of peptide synthesis reagents, general-purpose molecular building blocks, and protein reagents. These products are used in the synthesis of amide bonds in small molecule chemical drugs and peptide drugs. The company has also expanded into specialty products including lipid nanoparticles, ionic liquids, PROTAC reagents, and nucleotide reagents.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including automated production technology, crystal particle size control technology, impurity detection and control technology, pipeline reaction technology, selective protection technology for complex organic molecules with multiple functional groups, enzyme reaction technology, protein crosslinker membrane separation and purification technology, and low-temperature dehydration cyclization technology. The company operates through self-owned production facilities and outsourced manufacturing arrangements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 1,900 pharmaceutical research and production enterprises, CRO and CDMO companies globally. Key customers include multinational pharmaceutical companies like Eli Lilly, Lonza, Novo Nordisk, Pfizer, and domestic companies like WuXi AppTec, Asymchem, Kanglong Chemical, and Boehringer Ingelheim. The company also serves leading reagent suppliers like Thermo Fisher and Sigma-Aldrich, as well as over 60 universities and research institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Suzhou High-tech Zone. It has established production facilities in Anqing, Anhui Province through its subsidiary Anhui Highfine. The company conducts international business with customers across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific regions, with foreign sales representing 32.60% of total revenue in 2023.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It provides specialty chemical reagents and building blocks used by pharmaceutical companies in drug research and development and manufacturing. The company is positioned as a supplier of critical materials for drug synthesis and development processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) expanding the peptide synthesis reagent product portfolio with new high-efficiency reagents; (2) developing molecular building blocks with higher technical barriers and market demand; (3) advancing lipid nanoparticle and lipid formulation reagents for mRNA vaccines and gene therapy; (4) developing PROTAC reagents, nucleotide reagents, and non-natural amino acids; (5) increasing self-owned production capacity through facility expansion in Anhui and planned additional production bases.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of specialty chemical reagents and molecular building blocks to pharmaceutical companies, CRO/CDMO firms, and research institutions. Revenue is recognized when control of products transfers to customers, typically upon delivery. The company also generates revenue from technical services and custom product development for clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a market leader in peptide synthesis reagents, particularly in phosphonium and uronium-type condensing reagents (HATU, HBTU, TBTU, PyBOP). Major competitors include Bachem AG and Olon S.p.A. internationally. The company has established strong competitive advantages through comprehensive product portfolios, quality control, reliable supply, and long-term customer relationships. The company is positioned as a preferred supplier for many pharmaceutical R&D and production enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of 388.79 million yuan, down 13.11% from 447.46 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 98.97 million yuan, down 23.50% from 129.37 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 2.287 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 281.13% from 600.05 million yuan at year-end 2022, primarily due to IPO proceeds. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in July 2023, raising 165.54 billion yuan in net proceeds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive product portfolio with 160+ peptide synthesis reagents covering full synthesis process requirements; (2) superior product quality with excellent purity and batch consistency validated by major pharmaceutical companies; (3) reliable and timely supply capabilities; (4) technical expertise enabling rapid custom product development; (5) strong customer relationships with high switching costs due to regulatory requirements for process validation; (6) innovation in high-barrier specialty products like protein crosslinkers and lipid nanoparticles; (7) 20+ years of industry experience and technical accumulation.
